alcohol.answer: Asiana prohibits alcoholic beverages of 70% or more alcohol in the cabin. Duty-free alcohol bought at airport shops may go in the cabin only when sealed in a security tamper-evident bag. Its Restricted Items page gives no litre limit for checked alcohol.

sections.p: From the Asiana Restricted Items page (US site, English), read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Asiana rule
rows: Alcohol with 70% or higher alcohol content
Listed as an explosive or flammable material prohibited in the cabin
Duty-free alcohol bought at an airport
Allowed in the cabin only when sealed in a security tamper-evident bag
Liquids in the cabin on international flights
Containers of 100 ml or less in one transparent resealable 1-litre bag, one bag per passenger
Rules depend on the transit country; the page lists country by country (for example Taiwan: duty-free liquids may not go in cabin baggage on a transfer, only as checked baggage)

list: Not on the page: a litre limit for alcohol in checked baggage.

faq: Can I carry duty-free alcohol on Asiana?
Yes, in the cabin when it is sealed in a security tamper-evident bag. On a transfer it may still be confiscated under the transit country's rules.
Is strong alcohol banned on Asiana?
Alcohol with 70% or higher alcohol content is prohibited in the cabin.
